feeds.title: PRA Air Conditioning Blog
feeds.description: PRA Air Conditioning strives to achieve the best results time after time, job after job, no matter how large or how small. They provide full air conditioning installations, maintenance, cleaning and air con repairs services for a wide range of customers across the UK. Their services include installation and maintenance in offices, shops, surgeries and waiting rooms, pharmacies, salons, industrial premises as well as domestic premises. Read blogs for tips, articles, tricks, and more HVAC.

feeds.title: Lee Jackson Air Conditioning Blog
feeds.description: Lee Jackson Air Conditioning has been providing high quality, commercial air conditioning solutions for over 15 years. Their expert team has unrivalled experience in installing and maintaining systems for a broad range of industries. They work with a range of businesses across the UK from boutique hotels and shops to expansive, multi-floor commercial office buildings. They have consistently adapted their service over the years to ensure they always provide the latest technology at competitive prices. Browse their blog for more information on all things air conditioning.

feeds.title: D-Air Blog
feeds.description: They are here to help you get the best air conditioning solution for your home or business. Whether you need installation, servicing or repair, here's what they offer all their customers. Get reliable advice from experts with 25+ years of industry experience. They are experienced and certified suppliers and installers of more than 10 leading air conditioner manufacturers. Stay up to date with the latest air conditioning news and advice with the D-Air blog.

feeds.title: Cross Rental Services Blog
feeds.description: Cross Hire services offers a comprehensive range of boiler hire options, all bespoke built in their UK facility. Their all inclusive service includes a free site survey where one of their qualified sales engineers will assess your circumstances on site to give you a specific, tailored solution. They have a great range of portable units; ideal for you air purification, dehumidification and drying needs. The blog includes a number of industry articles, tips & informative posts about the various components of HVAC.

feeds.title: SDH Building Services
feeds.description: SDH Building Services are installers and suppliers of air conditioning, ventilation, heating and electrical systems, for offices, supermarkets, hotels, restaurants, factory units and schools across the UK. Their fully qualified and experienced engineers aim to reduce the stress of installing or servicing air conditioning, ventilation, heating and electrical systems in your clients' projects. The blog offers a range of interesting and insightful news and blog articles, industry information and company information for you to read.

feeds.title: I-HT Air Conditioning Installation Blog
feeds.description: With over 32 years' experience installing hundreds of air conditioning systems for businesses & homes across England. I-HT air conditioning installation gets the job done right first time. It is committed to providing the very best service and air conditioning units at a budget that suits you. It specializes in installing and maintaining heat pump air conditioning systems manufactured by all the leading brands, Fujitsu, Daikin, Mitsubishi to name a few. Check out their blog for air conditioning, benefits, reducing emission, and more.

feeds.title: BFM Magazine
feeds.description: Browse some blog posts to learn about HVAC, maintenance, benefits, and more. The Building and Facilities Management magazine is your go-to resource for learning about energy, sustainability, corporate partners, waste management, and much more.

feeds.title: T K Refrigeration Blog
feeds.description: Tim Rogers founded TKR in 1981. We have a team of qualified, experienced service and maintenance engineers. We can repair, supply, and install storage refrigerators and freezers, ice machines, blast chillers, and air conditioning heat pump systems, as well as all warewashing equipment.

feeds.title: H&V News Magazine
feeds.description: H&V News Magazine is the leading resource for the latest news and insights in the heating, ventilating and air conditioning industry. It is the voice of HVAC for 60+ years & organizer, the H&V Awards. Explore the blog for news, articles, tips, and more on AC.

feeds.title: REMARS Blog
feeds.description: REMARS is an experienced Mechanical, Electrical, Public Health (MEP) Consulting Engineering practice based in the North West of England, in Warrington and in London. They are a consulting engineers practice, dedicated to providing high quality, value-driven design, build and manage solutions. They work across most sectors and at all stages of a building's life cycle - from inception through to demolition. Check out the blog for informative articles and news on HVAC, MEP, M&E, BIM, new projects, and more.

feeds.title: Mid-Tech Services » HVAC Blog
feeds.description: Read Mid-Tech Services latest news and blog articles to keep up to date with everything you need to know about HVAC. Formed in 2008, Mid-Tech Services is aspiring to achieve continual and sustainable growth, combined with the drive, enthusiasm and ambition to make a real difference to the service levels delivered to their clients. From initially delivering air conditioning, heating and ventilation maintenance they have expanded their service offering a full range of building services and fabric works.

feeds.title: Westcott Air Conditioning Blog
feeds.description: Westcott Air Conditioning has been temperature-controlling your environment since 1966. It offers a range of professional services designed to make our customers more comfortable. Working throughout the Midlands and the UK, their HVAC contractors have the skills, resources, and experience needed to install top-of-the-range HVAC systems for all types of premises. Read the latest news and company developments from Westcott Air Conditioning.
